items.a: Technically yes — but this system took 50+ hours: ready boards, auto tracking, charts, and daily reminders. Instead of weeks of trial and error, you start today for less than a coffee.

items.q: I tried trackers before and quit — what's different?
items.a: Most trackers are either too complex or boring. Ours is built on one idea: when you see progress, it's hard to stop. Streaks, points, and daily planning take just 5 minutes. Simple enough to stick, fun enough to want to.
None at all. After subscribing you open your dashboard, add habits, and mark wins daily. Points, streaks, and charts update automatically.
Yes — phone, tablet, or laptop in the browser. Most members log habits on mobile in the morning and review the dashboard on desktop.
Monthly with a 1-day free trial. After day one it renews each month; cancel anytime from your dashboard. No hidden fees.

items.q: What if I don't like it?
items.a: You have 21 days to try it. If it's not for you for any reason, contact us for a full refund — no hassle.

items.q: How do I get access after purchase?
items.a: After payment, create your account from the thank-you page and enter your dashboard instantly. Everything is in-app: habits, tasks, and daily analytics for your plan.
